evidence: Lessons: (1) an empty rule set read as 'No violations' — any sensor with zero inputs must say 'not analyzed', never pass; (2) 'no data' as an optional field keeps every output schema valid, where an error would lose the reason for the user; (3) one folder layout (.semgrep/architecture/) lets one agent-generated rule set serve the analyzer, PR review, and the kit's audit; (4) process: starting dependent tasks while the e2e ran was caught by asdd check (dependency order, shared owner).
